## Deep Technical Case Studies

### 1. High-Performance WebGL 3D Simulation Architecture (Metropolyca)
- **Challenge:** Running complex metropolitan economic simulations and living citizen AI at 60 FPS in a web browser without memory leaks.
- **Solution:** Engineered modular TypeScript simulation engine with strict state separation, WebGL rendering, and automated regression testing.
- **Metrics:** Instant 60 FPS rendering, 150+ automated unit and integration tests passed.
- **Repository:** https://github.com/netssv/metropolyca

### 2. POSIX Edge Network & SSL Triage Terminal (WhatHappened)
- **Challenge:** Web administrators and marketing ops teams struggle with cumbersome terminal commands for edge DNS, DoH, and SSL certificate inspection during live incidents.
- **Solution:** Built and published a Manifest V3 Chrome Extension offering a POSIX-style interactive CLI emulator with DNS-over-HTTPS and TLS handshakes.
- **Store URL:** https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/whathappened/jkohefabbnobompohkedfaodcnfdplom

### 3. Hardware Profiler for Open-Source AI Quantization (caniarun)
- **Challenge:** Developers need rapid verification of GPU VRAM capacity against 80+ open LLMs across GGUF quantization tiers (Q4, Q8, FP16).
- **Solution:** Developed an open-source Python CLI package distributed via PyPI that profiles local CUDA hardware and outputs instant compatibility matrices.
- **Package URL:** https://pypi.org/project/caniarun/

### 4. Zero-Dollar Serverless Market Telemetry Pipeline (HODL Watcher)
- **Challenge:** Delivering continuous, real-time market payload ingestion without incurring server infrastructure overhead.
- **Solution:** Orchestrated Make.com cron watchdogs triggering Python FastAPI microservices on Render cloud with in-memory caching.
- **Metrics:** Autonomous $0/month operational cloud cost with 99.9% uptime.
- **Demo:** https://hodl-watcher.vercel.app/
